name: mercury
description: Banking from Mercury. Spend analysis, anomaly detection, and cash reconciliation.

skills.name: mercury-mcp
skills.description: Use whenever the user asks about their Mercury bank accounts, balances, transactions, spend, cards, statements, recipients, or cashflow. Covers how to use the Mercury MCP tools correctly: complete pagination, date anchoring with getCurrentDate, postedStart/postedEnd filtering, th

skills.name: mercury-analyze-spend
skills.description: Analyze spending patterns across Mercury accounts with categorized breakdowns, counterparty grouping, and month-over-month comparisons. Use for questions like how much did we spend, where is spend growing, or what changed versus last month.

skills.name: mercury-detect-anomaly
skills.description: Detect anomalous Mercury transactions by building 90-day per-counterparty and per-category baselines and flagging pattern breaks in a recent window. Use for questions like anything unusual this week, new vendors, or unexpected charges.

skills.name: mercury-cash-reconciliation
skills.description: Produce the Mercury side of a cash General Ledger reconciliation for a given account and period, formatted to drop into a Mercury Reconciliation Workbook.

subagents.name: mercury-analyst
subagents.description: Read-only Mercury analyst. Delegate here when a question needs many pages of Mercury transactions so the pagination and number-crunching stay out of the main conversation. Returns a short, computed answer.
